name: Matt Rife
bio: Matthew Steven Rife (born September 10, 1995) is an American comedian and actor from North Lewisburg, Ohio, best known for his self-produced comedy specials, Only Fans (2021) and Matthew Steven Rife (2023), as well as his appearance on the comedy competition series Bring the Funny.

credits.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
credits.overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

credits.title: I Live Here Now
credits.overview: Struggling actress Rose finds her life upended by unexpected news. Things spiral further when her casual boyfriend, Travis, brings his overbearing mother into the fold, pushing Rose to the brink. She flees to The Crown Inn—a crumbling motel at the edge of nowhere—where time fractures and reality bends.

credits.title: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special
credits.overview: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.

credits.title: Kill Tony: Mayhem at Madison Square Garden
credits.overview: With one minute to impress Tony Hinchcliffe and his star-studded panel, newbie stand-ups risk it all on the hallowed ground of Madison Square Garden.

credits.title: LowKey Comedy Special
credits.overview: Follows comedians who perform and participate in improvised, interview-style segments that create unique interactions with the audience.

credits.title: Trapped Inn
credits.overview: An American cycling team trains at a remote European lodge. Teammates start dying mysteriously. Rivals Connor and Greg battle to survive and uncover the cause behind the team's demise.

credits.title: Matt Rife: Lucid - A Crowd Work Special
credits.overview: In Netflix's first-ever crowd work special, Matt Rife gets up close and personal with an unpredictable Charlotte audience to riff on all things dreams.

credits.title: Murder at Hollow Creek
credits.overview: A disbarred lawyer and his eccentric brother attempt to pull off the robbery of a lifetime but find themselves in a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a disgruntled Serbian mobster.

credits.title: Karma: Death at Latigo Springs
credits.overview: Charley Stevens moves to the town where her recently deceased mother grew up; after arriving, he is plagued with strange nightmares that tease a horrific event, hinting at why her mother left town.

credits.title: The Private Eye
credits.overview: Private investigator Mort Madison's life begins spiraling downward when a beguiling, slightly familiar woman hires him for his most unusual case.

credits.title: Don't Suck
credits.overview: Pete Brennan is a middle-aged stand-up comedian who’s spent half his life chasing laughs in dingy dive bars & diners. When given a last shot at stardom to appear on a network special starring Russell Peters, he goes on tour to prepare. credits.title: Matt Rife: Natural Selection
credits.overview: From his problem with protection crystals to his beef with social media trolls, comedian Matt Rife holds nothing back in this rollicking stand-up special.

credits.title: Matthew Steven Rife
credits.overview: Matt Rife’s new self-titled special is the perfect look into his charismatic wit. In his second self-produced hour special, built by friends and fans, Matt pushes comedic boundaries with stories, improv, and positive messages.

credits.title: Wolf Mountain
credits.overview: Aj and his brother revisit the spot where their parents were killed. But legend has it there is something mysterious roaming these woods.

credits.title: North of the 10
credits.overview: The story of five friends struggling to succeed in Chicago's entertainment industry while one of them pursues an international romance with a wealthy young heiress.

credits.title: Matt Rife: Only Fans
credits.overview: Comedian Matt Rife discusses his world of deceptive good looks, women and even a charismatic perspective of the world's more pressing topics.

credits.title: Death Link
credits.overview: In the age of social media, teenagers tell the story that they want people to see, with each video more daring than the next. But in this small town, a series of staged "murder" videos are turning very real.

credits.title: The Elevator
credits.overview: Roman Juniper, a husband and father of three, is forced to go work on the Saturday of his daughter's birthday. He intends to make it back home in time for cake, but a sharp turn of events leads his family to believe their patriarch is in grave danger.

credits.title: ATL Comedy Arts Fest, Volume 2
credits.overview: Best of the ATL Comedy & Arts Festival, Volume 2.  Best of the Fest.

credits.title: Stalked by My Doctor: A Sleepwalker's Nightmare
credits.overview: The devious Dr. Albert Beck finds his latest stalking victim after changing his identity and beginning work at a sleep clinic.

credits.title: American Typecast
credits.overview: A struggling Middle-Eastern American actor, perpetually typecast as a terrorist, is forced to embrace his stereotype in order to save lives on and off the big screen.

credits.title: Black Pumpkin
credits.overview: On October 31st, two preteens in a small town accidentally awaken an evil that has lain dormant for decades. They are forced to survive through a terrifying Halloween night of cat-and-mouse, from the monster known as "Bloody Bobby."
